body:
As an intuitive method to be awake and alert to my own I began to fast some 2 month ago.
I'lost 20 kgs after tree weeks of a strong efort trying to be of doing MY SELF and do not consume any thing more.( TV, Food etc)
I've been fasting with a really minimal food intake. After some 4-5 days, I lost my apettite and I could cope with the fast with some kind of interior happy feellings.
After to month of fasting, having lost 20 kgs, I didn´t find nothing more that my self as allways, a little bit weak and without nothing important to tell you.
Regards.
Now I began to smoke MariJuana to try to get some new perspective of my life !
